0022600005.text: The Lakers host the Golden State Warriors in the Lakers' first game of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
